# @prestgg/solid-ui — full component reference

# split

Splits props into the keys a component handles and the rest it forwards. Solid 2 dropped `splitProps`; `omit` alone does not return a tuple.

# cn

Class-name merger built on clsx and tailwind-merge. Every component uses it.

Dependencies: clsx, tailwind-merge

# slot

Radix's Slot for Solid: style the caller's element instead of the component's own.

# polymorphic

Render a chosen element and forward the rest, without a headless primitive.

# variants

cva-compatible variant function, without the dependency.

# presence

Keeps a subtree mounted until its exit animation has played.

# focus-trap

Confines Tab to a container and restores focus when it closes.

# scroll-lock

Reference-counted body scroll lock for nested overlays.

# roving-focus

The roving-tabindex pattern for menus, tabs and toggle groups.

# floating

Positioning for popovers, menus and selects, via @floating-ui/dom.

Dependencies: @floating-ui/dom

# dismissable

Close-on-outside-press and Escape, safe inside nested overlays.

# portal

Render into document.body, resolved lazily so SSR is safe.

# button

The button, with six variants, eight sizes and asChild.

# input

A text input.

# textarea

A multi-line input that grows with its content.

# label

A form label, paired with a control through for/id.

# badge

A small status label.

# card

A surface with a header, content and footer.

# separator

A one-pixel rule.

# skeleton

A pulsing placeholder for content that has not loaded.

# kbd

A keyboard key, and a group of keys pressed together.

# spinner

A loading indicator, inline SVG with no icon dependency.

# aspect-ratio

A box that keeps a fixed width-to-height ratio.

# table

A data table with header, body, footer, rows and cells.

# alert

A callout with a title and a description.

# avatar

A portrait with a fallback.

# breadcrumb

The trail of ancestors for the current page.

# pagination

Page navigation, built from real anchors.

# progress

A progress bar, with an indeterminate mode.

# checkbox

A checkbox on a real input, so it takes part in form submission.

# switch

An on/off toggle on a real checkbox input.

# radio-group

Mutually exclusive options, on real radio inputs.

# slider

A range input over a styled track.

# native-select

The platform select, styled. For few options, where the native picker wins.

# toggle

A two-state button, announced with aria-pressed.

# toggle-group

Toggles that behave as one control, single or multi-select.

# button-group

Joins adjacent buttons or inputs into one control.

# item

One row of a list: media, text, actions.

# empty

The nothing-here-yet state, with a way out.

# form

A validated form on @prestgg/formbox, with a submit button that reports its busy state.

Dependencies: @prestgg/formbox

# field

One control with its label, description and error, wired together by id.

Dependencies: @prestgg/formbox

# collapsible

One region that shows or hides, with a trigger that reports its state.

# accordion

Several disclosures where opening one can close the others. One tab stop, arrows between triggers.

# tabs

Panels switched by one tab stop. Automatic activation switches as focus moves; manual waits for Enter.

# scroll-area

A scrollable region with styled scrollbars, on native scrolling.

# resizable

Panels separated by a divider that drags, and resizes with the arrow keys.

# select

A listbox in a floating panel. Arrows move the active option; Space commits it.

# dropdown-menu

A menu of actions. One tab stop, arrows between items, Escape returns focus to the trigger.

# combobox

A text input that filters a list of options, matching text as a case-insensitive substring.

# command

A filterable command palette. The DOM is the list, so filtering cannot drift from what is shown.

# carousel

Slides with previous/next controls and dots. No drag engine — the state machine, not the gesture layer.

# input-otp

A one-time-code field. One hidden input drives the boxes, so paste and SMS autofill work.

# chart

A themed chart container with SVG primitives. Same config shape and --color-N mapping as shadcn, without Recharts.

# sonner

A stack of transient messages, plus the toast() function. The one component you import rather than copy.

# navigation-menu

A bar of links with panels that fly out of the item. Hover-opened, Escape-closable.

# dialog

A modal window: trapped focus, a locked page behind, Escape and scrim dismissal.

# alert-dialog

A dialog that interrupts to confirm. Focus starts on Cancel, so the safe choice is the resting state.

# sheet

A dialog that slides in from an edge.

# drawer

A panel that springs up from the bottom, for phone menus.

# popover

A floating panel on a trigger. Non-modal: the page behind stays live.

# hover-card

A preview panel on hover, with open and close delays so it does not flash in the way.

# tooltip

A short label for a control that has no visible text. Opens immediately; Escape dismisses.
